Happy one year my hibbuuuuuu 🥹❤️

Well ml, here we areeeee, a whole year together. Icl I genuinely don't even know where to start because there's so much I want to say to you, and I already know this is going to be one of those paragraphs where I just keep going on and on. But honestly, I don't even care because it's our one year and you deserve to know how much this past year has meant to me. It's actually crazy thinking that exactly 52 weeks ago we started this journey together, and now we're here celebrating our first anniversary. So much has happened in that time, so many memories have been made, and I genuinely couldn't have asked for a better person to experience all of it with. You've become such a big part of my life, ml, and I don't think I could ever properly explain how much you mean to me.

I still remember the first time I saw you in real life when I joined sixth form. I swearrrr, it genuinely feels like yesterday. It's so funny thinking about how things were back then compared to how they are now. We barely knew each other properly, and now you're the person I tell absolutely everything to. I never would've thought that the girl I saw when I first joined sixth form would end up becoming my girlfriend, let alone the person I'd be celebrating a whole year with. But I'm so glad things worked out the way they did, because getting to know you has genuinely been one of the best things that's happened to me.

And ml, can we please talk about those Instagram stories 😭. The sky pictures, the fireworks, all those little things you kept posting. You really thought I wasn't noticing, didn't you? I promise you I noticed every single one. I still find it so funny because looking back, it was so obvious what was going on, but at the time we were both trying to act like nothing was happening. You'd post something, I'd find an excuse to reply, and then we'd end up talking again. I was genuinely so happy whenever we'd have a conversation, even if it was about the most random thing ever. And the worst part is that I was trying so hard to act normal when really I just wanted to keep talking to you. So yes babyyy, your little plan worked, but don't get too happy about it.

One thing I genuinely love looking back on is that whole phase when we were first getting to know each other. Everything felt so new, and even the smallest interactions meant so much. Seeing you at sixth form, getting a message from you, replying to your stories, finding excuses to talk, all those little things made my days better. And it's not that I prefer those days to how things are now, because I love how comfortable we've become with each other. It's just nice remembering how it all started and how something that seemed so small at the time ended up becoming such a big part of my life. I sometimes wish I could go back and experience those first few moments again, just to remember exactly how I felt.

And then there's 17th March, my hibabaaaa. A date I genuinely don't think I'll ever forget. I don't even need to go into every little detail because you already know exactly what I'm talking about 😉. That's one thing I love about us, ml. We have so many memories that only we properly understand. Little moments at sixth form that probably wouldn't mean anything to anyone else, but to us they're something we'll always remember. All the times we'd be trying to act normal, laughing over absolutely nothing, and somehow finding ways to spend time together. I swearrrr, those days were actually so funny, and I still think about them sometimes.

And obviously, how could I ever forget our staircase step? 🥹🤍

I know it's literally just a step, but ml, that place means so much to me. All the times we'd sit there together, talking about anything and everything, laughing at the most random things, or just enjoying each other's company. I genuinely loved every single one of those moments. I remember you leaning on me while we sat there, and honestly, I don't think you realise how happy those little moments made me. We didn't need to go anywhere special or spend money doing anything. We could literally just sit on that staircase for ages and I'd be perfectly happy because I was spending time with you. I still smile sometimes when I walk past it because it reminds me of us and how many memories we've made there.

It's actually funny how certain places can become so special because of one person. To everyone else, it's just a normal staircase at sixth form, but to me it's somewhere I'll always associate with you. Even years from now, In Sha Allah, I know I'll remember those moments. The conversations we'd have, the way we'd laugh, and how we'd somehow manage to spend so much time there without even realising. I don't think we appreciated at the time just how many memories we were making, but looking back now, those are genuinely some of my favourites from this whole year.

And honestly ml, that's something I've realised about being with you. It's not always the big things that make me happiest. Sometimes it's literally just being around you, talking about our days, getting food together or doing absolutely nothing. I love how comfortable we are with each other now. We don't always need to have something planned or somewhere to go. We can literally just sit together and somehow still have the best time. I love that we can talk about serious things one minute and then be laughing at something completely stupid the next. It's those little moments that make our relationship feel so special to me.

AND OBVIOUSLY, WE HAVE TO TALK ABOUT PEPESSSS 😭.

I swearrrr, our little food dates are genuinely some of my favourite memories. There's just something about ordering food together, sitting down and eating while talking about absolutely anything. Especially when it's Pepe's because yk how much we love that. I don't know why, but food genuinely tastes better when I'm eating with you. Even if we're just being lazy and doing nothing for the rest of the day, I still enjoy every second of it. I can't wait for all the other places we're going to try together, all the random food dates we'll have and all the times we'll probably spend ages deciding what to eat just to end up ordering the same thing again.

And babyyy, I love all our little routines as well. The things we do without even thinking about them anymore, the random conversations we have, the little jokes that only make sense to us, and all the ways we've become part of each other's everyday lives. Sometimes I don't think we even realise how much those things matter until we look back on them. There are so many little moments from this year that I wish I could experience again, not because anything particularly exciting happened, but simply because I was happy being there with you.

I also love how I can be completely myself around you, ml. I don't feel like I have to pretend to be someone else or constantly think about what I'm saying. I can be silly, annoying, serious, quiet, or just completely random, and you already know what I'm like. And yes, I know I can be very annoying sometimes, but let's not act like you're innocent either 😭. I genuinely love winding you up, even though I know you're probably reading this and thinking about all the times I've annoyed you. But that's just one of the things I love about us. We can tease each other, laugh about stupid things and still know how much we care about one another.

And yk what, ml? I genuinely love how much we've gotten to know each other throughout this year. At the beginning, there were so many things we didn't know about each other. Now I feel like I understand you in ways I never could've imagined back then. I know the little things that make you happy, the things that annoy you, the things you care about and the things that matter to you. And even now, I still feel like there's so much more for us to learn about each other. That's something I'm looking forward to as well, because I don't want us to ever stop making an effort to understand one another.

I know I joke around with you a lot, babyyy, and sometimes I probably don't say things as seriously as I should, but I genuinely appreciate you so much. I appreciate the time you make for me, the effort you put into our relationship, and all the little things you do that you probably don't even realise I notice. I appreciate when you listen to me, when you try to understand how I'm feeling, and when you make an effort even when things aren't easy. I don't ever want you to think those things go unnoticed because I promise you they don't.

And I want to thank you for being patient with me as well, ml. I know I'm not perfect, and I know there have been times when I could've handled things better. Sometimes I might not explain myself properly, sometimes I might get things wrong, and sometimes I might not realise how something has made you feel until we actually talk about it. But I want you to know that I'm always willing to learn and improve because you genuinely mean that much to me. I don't want to just tell you how much I love you; I want to make sure I show you through my actions too.

Because let's be honest, my love, this year hasn't always been easy. We've had our disagreements, misunderstandings and difficult moments. There have been times when things felt overwhelming, and I know we've both had moments where we probably could've communicated better. But I don't want to pretend those things never happened, because they're part of our journey too. And I think one of the most important things we've learnt is that being together isn't just about enjoying the good moments. It's also about understanding each other when things aren't going perfectly.

I'm genuinely proud of the way we've been able to learn from things, ml. I know there's still so much for us to improve on, and I'm not going to sit here and pretend we'll never have another disagreement because that wouldn't be realistic. But what I do know is that I want us to keep communicating properly, listening to each other and making sure we both feel understood. I want us to be able to talk about anything without feeling like we have to hide how we're feeling. I want us to keep growing, not just as a couple but as individuals too.

And I hope you know that whenever something is bothering you, you can talk to me about it. Whether it's something I've done, something that's happened during your day, or something completely unrelated to us, I want you to feel comfortable telling me. I might not always have the perfect advice or know exactly what to say, but I'll always try my best to listen and understand. Your feelings matter to me, ml, and I never want you to feel like you have to keep things to yourself just because you don't want to worry me.

I want to be someone who makes you feel appreciated and supported. Someone who celebrates your achievements, encourages you when you're working towards something and reminds you how capable you are when you're doubting yourself. I genuinely want to see you do well in everything you put your mind to, babyyy. You've got so much ahead of you, and I hope you achieve every single thing you've been hoping for, In Sha Allah. And I hope I get to be there celebrating those moments with you.

I also want you to know that I appreciate you for who you are, not just for what you do for me. I love your personality, your sense of humour, the way you talk, the random things you say and all those little things that make you you. I love how you can make me laugh without even trying, and how sometimes a simple conversation with you can make a difficult day feel so much better. I don't think you realise just how often you make me smile, even when we're not physically together.

It's actually crazy how much you've become part of my everyday life. Whenever something happens, you're usually one of the first people I want to tell. If I see something funny, I want to send it to you. If something reminds me of one of our memories, I immediately think about you. Even the most random things can remind me of us, whether it's a song, a place, a picture of the sky or literally just someone mentioning Pepe's. And I think that's one of the nicest things about having someone you love in your life. You start associating so many little things with them without even realising.

And ml, I genuinely can't wait for all the memories we still have to make together. We've already experienced so much in this first year, but there's still so much we haven't done. So many places we haven't visited, so many foods we haven't tried, so many pictures we haven't taken and so many random days out we haven't planned yet. I want us to keep doing new things together, even if they're simple. I want more little food dates, more days where we just spend time together, more pictures of us and more moments that we'll look back on and laugh about.

I can't wait for all the times we'll look through our old pictures and remember what was happening when we took them. I know there are already so many photos that bring back memories for me, and I hope we keep adding to them. Imagine us looking back at our sixth form pictures a few years from now, remembering our staircase step and laughing about how things started between us. I genuinely hope we get to experience that together, In Sha Allah. It would be so nice to look back and see how much we've grown since those first few months.

And I know I've said this already, but I really do hope we never stop appreciating the small things. I don't want us to get so caught up in everything going on around us that we forget to enjoy the time we have together. Even when we're busy with school, exams, work or whatever else life brings, I hope we still make time for each other and keep doing the things that make us happy. It doesn't always have to be something expensive or exciting. Sometimes just being able to sit together and talk is more than enough for me.

I also want us to keep having fun together, ml. I never want our relationship to become something where everything feels too serious or stressful. Of course there are going to be times when we need to have proper conversations, but I hope we always keep that silly side of us too. The random jokes, the teasing, the laughing over absolutely nothing, all those little things. I love being able to act completely unserious around you, and I hope we still have that same energy years from now.

And babyyy, I hope you never feel like you have to change who you are for me. I love you for the person you already are, and I want you to keep being yourself. I want you to have your own goals, your own interests, your own friends and all the things that make you happy. I want us to support each other while also giving each other the space to grow. I think that's really important, especially as we're both still figuring out so much about life and what we want for our futures.

I genuinely hope that as we get older, we can look back at this first year and be proud of the way we've treated each other and the memories we've made. I hope we remember the good moments, learn from the difficult ones and continue building something that makes us both happy. I know nobody can predict exactly what the future will look like, but I do know that I want to keep making an effort for you and for us.

And that's another thing I want to say, ml. I don't ever want you to feel like I take you for granted just because we've been together for a while. I still want to make you feel special, surprise you sometimes, write you little messages and remind you how much you mean to me. I know an anniversary is a nice excuse to do all those things, but I don't want it to be the only time I show you how much I care. You deserve that effort throughout the year too.

That's actually one of the reasons I wanted to make this website for you. I wanted to do something a little different for our first anniversary, something that you could look through and remember all the little moments we've shared. I wanted it to be more than just a message on your phone. I wanted somewhere to put our pictures, our memories, our favourite moments and all the things that remind me of us. I know it's not going to include every single memory because there are genuinely too many, but I hope it shows you how much thought I've put into celebrating our first year together.

And yes, I know I'm writing an absolutely massive paragraph right now, but you should've expected this from me 😭. It's our one year, ml. I couldn't just write you a few lines and call it a day. There's genuinely so much I want to thank you for and so much I want to tell you. And even after writing all of this, I still feel like there are things I haven't mentioned. That's how much this year has meant to me.

I want to thank you for all the happy memories we've made. For every time you've made me laugh, every conversation we've had, every moment we've spent together and every little thing you've done to show me you care. Thank you for the days when we've done something exciting, but also for the days when we've literally done nothing. Thank you for making ordinary moments feel special just because you're there.

Thank you for our staircase memories, for all those little moments at sixth form and for everything that happened on 17th March. Thank you for all our food dates, especially our Pepe's ones, because I genuinely don't think I'll ever stop mentioning those. Thank you for all the pictures, the random conversations, the inside jokes and the memories that only we properly understand. Those are the things I'll always look back on with so much happiness.

And thank you for staying patient with me when things have been difficult. Thank you for giving us opportunities to understand each other better and for the effort you've put into making things work. I know relationships take effort from both people, and I appreciate the times you've shown that you're willing to put that effort in. I want to keep doing the same for you because I know how important it is that we both feel valued.

I also want to say sorry for the times I've upset you or made you feel misunderstood. I know saying sorry doesn't automatically fix everything, and I don't want to make promises without following through on them. But I genuinely want to keep becoming better at communicating, being patient and understanding things from your perspective. You deserve that, ml, and I want to make sure I'm doing my part.

And please know that even when we disagree about something, it doesn't change how much I care about you. We can have different opinions, we can get frustrated and we can need time to think about things, but I still want us to treat each other with kindness and respect. I want us to be able to work through things properly instead of letting small misunderstandings turn into bigger problems. I want us to feel like we're on the same team, even when we're trying to figure something out.

I think that's one of the things I've learnt most from this year. Loving someone isn't just about the happy moments or the cute things you say to each other. It's about making the effort to understand them, respecting their feelings and being willing to admit when you're wrong. And I genuinely want to keep learning those things with you, ml. I want us to keep improving and making our relationship something we're both happy to be part of.

And yk what, babyyy? I'm actually so excited for our future memories. Not because I think everything is going to be perfect, but because there's so much I want us to experience. I want us to visit new places, try new restaurants, take loads of pictures and make the most of the time we have together. I want us to have those random days where we don't even have a proper plan but somehow end up having the best time.

I want us to have more moments like our staircase step, where something so simple ends up becoming one of our favourite memories. I want us to keep finding little places and things that remind us of each other. And I hope that as time goes on, we'll have even more stories to tell about how we met, how things started and all the memories we've made since.

And In Sha Allah, I hope this is just the first of many anniversaries we'll get to celebrate together. I hope we can look back at this one and remember how excited we were, how much effort went into everything and how happy we were to have reached our first year. I genuinely hope we have so many more reasons to celebrate together in the future.

But even with all those things to look forward to, I don't want to forget how grateful I am for what we already have. This past year has given me so many memories that I genuinely treasure. From the very beginning, when we were still finding excuses to talk, to all the moments we've shared since, I'm so thankful that I've been able to experience them with you.

Sometimes I think about how differently things could've turned out if we hadn't started talking properly. If you hadn't posted those stories, if I hadn't replied, or if we'd just carried on with our normal lives without getting to know each other. It's actually strange to think about because something that seemed so small at the time ended up becoming such a big part of my life. And I'm genuinely so glad it did.

I'm glad I got to know you beyond those first impressions. I'm glad we got comfortable enough to be ourselves around each other. I'm glad we've made memories that we'll always associate with one another. And I'm glad that after a whole year, I still have so much I want to experience with you.

My hibabaaaa, I hope you know how loved and appreciated you are. I know I don't always find the perfect words to explain how I feel, and sometimes I probably say something stupid instead of being serious, but I genuinely mean it when I tell you that you mean so much to me. You've brought so much happiness into my life this year, and I don't want you to ever think I don't appreciate that.

I love the little things about you, ml. The way you can make me laugh, the way you tell me about your day, the random conversations we end up having and the way we can be completely comfortable around each other. I love that we have our own memories, our own jokes and our own little routines. I love that there are so many things that instantly remind me of you.

And most importantly, I love you for being you. Not because everything is always perfect or because we never disagree, but because you're genuinely someone I care about so much. I appreciate your personality, your kindness, your effort and the way you've become such an important part of my life.

I hope this next year brings us so much happiness, ml. I hope we both do well in everything we're working towards, that we achieve our goals and that we continue supporting each other through everything life brings. I hope we make loads more memories, go on more food dates, take more pictures and have even more random conversations that somehow turn into our favourite moments.

I hope we keep learning how to understand each other better, keep being patient with each other and keep finding ways to make each other happy. I want us to keep enjoying the little things and never forget how much they matter. And I hope we always make time to appreciate each other, even when life gets busy.

And babyyy, I really hope you enjoy everything I've put together for you. I've genuinely wanted to make this anniversary special because it's our first one, and I know how much it means to both of us. I hope when you're looking through the website, you remember all the little moments we've shared and realise just how much they've meant to me.

I hope you look at our pictures and remember the days we took them. I hope you look at our memories and laugh about all the random things we've done. And I hope that when you read this letter, you understand how grateful I am to have spent this past year with you.

I know this has been a ridiculously long paragraph, but honestly, I could probably keep writing for another hour. There's just so much I want to say, and I don't think one message could ever include everything. But if there's one thing I want you to take away from all of this, it's that I genuinely love you so much and appreciate every little moment we've shared.

I don't know exactly what the future holds for us, ml, but I know what I hope for. I hope we continue making each other happy, continue growing together and continue making memories that we'll look back on with a smile. I hope we get to experience so many more firsts together and celebrate so many more milestones, In Sha Allah.

And I want you to know that I'll always try my best to be someone you can rely on, someone who listens to you, supports you and makes you feel appreciated. I want to keep putting effort into us, even on ordinary days when there's nothing special happening. Because you mean so much more to me than just an anniversary or a cute message.

So, happy one year again, my hibbuuuu. Happy one year to my favourite person, my babyyy, my hibabaaaa, my girl and the person who has given me so many memories this past year. Thank you for being you, for being part of my life and for everything we've experienced together.

I genuinely can't wait for all the memories we still have ahead of us. More laughs, more food dates, more little adventures, more pictures and hopefully many more anniversaries together, In Sha Allah. And no matter how many memories we make, I know I'll always have a special place in my heart for this first year and everything that came with it.

I love you sooooo much, my hibbuu. More than I probably manage to show sometimes, and definitely more than I can fit into one paragraph, even one as long as this 😭❤️.

Thank you for one beautiful year, my love. Here's to all the memories we've made and all the ones we still have to look forward to.

And just so you know, ml, I'll always be yours. Not just because it's our anniversary and I'm feeling all emotional, but because I genuinely want to keep choosing you, appreciating you and making an effort for us. I hope we get to spend many more years making each other happy, In Sha Allah.

okay ml, one more thing before you goooo 🥹

HIBBUUUUUUU MY LOVEEEEEE 😭❤️

Okay sooooo, you probably thought we were done after all those pages didn't you??? WELL NOPEEEE HEHEHEHE. I couldn't possibly make you a whole website for our one year and not leave you with one final message from me. And before you start saying that I've written too much, YES I KNOWWWW, but you've literally been my favourite person for an entire year now so you're just gonna have to deal with me being extra for a little longer 😭❤️

But okay ml, jokes aside for a second. There's actually something I really wanna tell you, and I want you to read this properly because I mean every single word of it.

Hibba, I know I'm not always the easiest person to deal with. I know I can be such an annoyance sometimes, and I KNOWWW there are moments where I'm unnecessarily rude, stubborn or just being a complete idiot for absolutely no reason. Sometimes I say things without properly thinking about how they're gonna make you feel, and sometimes I let my mood get the better of me when I really shouldn't. And I don't wanna sit here and pretend like I'm perfect because I'm genuinely not. I know there have been times where I've upset you, where I could've handled things so much better, and where you deserved a much nicer response from me. And for those moments, I'm genuinely sorry, my Hibbuu. You deserve to be spoken to with love and respect, even when we're annoyed at each other, and I never want you thinking otherwise.

And I wanna make something clear ml. I'm not saying all of this just because it's our anniversary or because I wanna make you emotional reading some massive paragraph 😭. I'm saying it because I actually recognise the things I need to work on. I don't want to keep making the same mistakes and then just saying sorry afterwards. I wanna show you that I'm learning, that I'm listening and that I'm genuinely putting effort into becoming better. I know that change doesn't happen overnight, and I know that a promise means so much more when it's backed up by actions. So I'm not gonna sit here and tell you that I'll never make another mistake, because that wouldn't be realistic. But what I CAN promise you is that I'm going to keep trying my absolute best to be more patient, to think before I speak, to listen properly when you're telling me how you feel and to never let my frustration become an excuse to be rude to you. I want you to actually see that effort, not just hear me talk about it.

Because Hibbuu, you genuinely mean so much more to me than I probably manage to explain sometimes. And I think that's something I need to get better at as well. It's so easy to say I love you, and trust me, I could say it about a million times a day and STILL not get bored 😭❤️, but I also want you to feel loved through the way I treat you. Through the way I speak to you, the way I reassure you, the way I make time for you and the way I handle things when we're not seeing eye to eye. I don't want the nicest version of me to only come out when everything's going perfectly. You deserve that same care and kindness on the difficult days too.

And do you know what else I've realised over this past year??? It's that being with someone isn't just about all the cute pictures, the dates, the little surprises and the good memories. Obviously I LOVE all of those things with you, and trust me we're gonna make SO MANY MORE IN SHA ALLAHHHH. But it's also about understanding each other, learning how the other person thinks, being honest when something's wrong and choosing to work through things properly rather than letting little problems turn into massive ones. We've both got so much growing up to do, ml, and I want us to be able to look back one day and see how much we've matured, both individually and together.

I also wanna thank you for something, my cutie. Thank you for the times you've been patient with me, for the times you've listened to me ramble about the most random things ever, and for the times you've made an ordinary day feel so much better without even realising. Thank you for letting me be the weirdest version of myself around you 😭. Thank you for all the little conversations that probably seemed completely normal at the time but ended up meaning so much to me. And thank you for being honest with me when something I've done has bothered you. I might not always respond perfectly in the moment, and that's something I'm working on, but I really do value you telling me how you feel.

Sometimes I think about how funny life is because imagine telling us back in that silent study room that we'd end up here, celebrating an entire year and having a whole website made about us 😭😭. LIKE BROOOO WHATTTT. From one little message about your music taste to all the memories we've made since, it's actually crazy how much has happened. And I love that our story isn't just made up of the big moments. It's all the tiny things too. The random looks across sixth form, the conversations that go on way longer than they were supposed to, the jokes that probably wouldn't make sense to anybody else, and those moments where I just look at you and think, yeah, that's my Hibbuuuu ❤️.

And speaking of sixth form, I actually can't wait to see what life looks like for us once we're finished with all of this. No more stressing over the same classrooms and timetables, hopefully some proper adventures, new places, little trips and all the things we've been talking about doing. WINTER WONDERLAND FIRST THOUGH, THAT IS NON-NEGOTIABLEEEE 😭🎡. I wanna see us ticking places off that bucket list one by one, taking the most ridiculous amount of pictures, getting lost somewhere because one of us can't read directions and then laughing about it afterwards. I don't know exactly what the future has planned for either of us, but I pray that it brings us both happiness, success, peace and plenty of beautiful memories, In Sha Allah.

And ml, while we're talking about the future, I want you to know that I'm proud of you. Not just for the things you've achieved, but for the person you are and the person you're becoming. I know life can get stressful and that there are days when everything feels like too much, but I hope you never forget how capable you are. I want you to chase your goals, do the things that make you happy and become everything you've always wanted to be. I'll always want the best for you, even on the days when you're doubting yourself. And I hope I can be someone who encourages you, supports you and makes things a little easier rather than harder.

I know we joke around a LOT, and half the time I'm probably annoying you on purpose just to get a reaction out of you 😭, BUTTT underneath all of that, I really do take what we have seriously. Your feelings matter to me. Your happiness matters to me. And the way I make you feel matters to me. I never wanna become someone who gets so comfortable that he stops appreciating the person in front of him. Just because we've reached one year doesn't mean I should stop making an effort. If anything, it means I should keep finding new ways to show you how important you are to me.

So here's my promise to you for our next year, Hibbuu. I'm going to try my best to be a better listener, a more patient person and someone who thinks about his words before saying them. I'm going to work on the things I know I need to improve, even when it's difficult. And when I do get something wrong, I want to take responsibility, understand what happened and actually learn from it. I want us to keep communicating honestly, laughing together, supporting each other and making memories without forgetting that kindness and respect are just as important as love. I can't promise perfection, ml, but I can promise genuine effort, and I intend to prove that through what I do.

AND NOWWWW BEFORE YOU START CRYINGGGG, I just wanna say one final thing 😭❤️.

Happy one year, my Hibbuuuu. ONE WHOLE YEARRRRR. I'm so grateful for the memories we've made, for everything we've learnt and for all the little moments that have brought us here. I hope this website made you smile, laugh, maybe shed a few happy tears HEHEHE, and most importantly reminded you just how much you mean to me. Every page, every picture, every song and every word was put here because I wanted to make something special for you.

Here's to another year of us learning, growing, being absolute idiots together and hopefully making even better memories than the last. May Allah bless us both with what's best for us, guide us to become better people and make the coming year a beautiful one, In Sha Allah.
